name: Dio Kuwakuwa
source:
Race: Animal people (monkey)
Blood type: Unknown
Zodiac sign: Unknown
Age: Unknown
Weapon: Earth magic

Dio is the chief of the Juujinkai, the animal people. One of the Guardians of the Rig Veda, he is the protector of earth and fights with earth magic. He is stubborn and non-trusting of humans, but also has a curiosity about them.
